models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Benign, light-air pattern over the Aeolians right now - but the trip dates are 10 days out and well beyond any model.
briefing.synopsis: Current runs show a weak, slack pressure pattern over the southern Tyrrhenian: light NE-E flow of 7-11 kt at the northern islands (Panarea 11.5 kt from 062, Stromboli 10.6 kt from 071 at midnight, ECMWF IFS 0.25 deg / AIFS / ICON-2i consensus, 22 Sep 12Z and 18Z runs), backing through N and then into the W quadrant by the 24th. By 24-25 Sep the whole group drops to 1-6 kt with wave and swell heights falling to 0.2-0.6 ft. Forecast coverage reaches only 29 Sep 23:00, so it stops six days short of the 4 Oct departure - nothing in this payload describes the trip itself.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: No fleet afloat tonight; the rehearsal run scores Portorosa Marina for the night of 23 Sep as sheltered, score 1.0, an enclosed basin with all-round shelter. That is a dry-run scoring against live weather, not a trip forecast. Nothing in the current data would push a boat out of Portorosa.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: The rehearsal 24 Sep window has Portorosa to Lipari at 4.6 kt on a beam reach, verdict 'go' with a 06:00 departure and no deterioration flagged - a motoring-or-drifting morning rather than a sailing one. Lipari itself falls to 2.4-2.7 kt from the NW-W through the 24th with waves 0.5-0.9 ft. For the actual 4 Oct start, the first genuinely useful guidance arrives around 27-29 Sep as the trip dates enter the 7-day window.

passage_notes.note: 4.6 kt beam reach, 'go', 06:00 depart. Rehearsal only.
6.8 kt broad reach, 'go'. Light and easy in the dry run.

passage_notes.leg: Lipari - Stromboli optional (rehearsal 26 Sep; trip 5 Oct)
passage_notes.note: 7.8 kt head to wind - motoring leg; IFS interval-max gust 20 kt against an 8 kt mean, reported not treated as a caution.

passage_notes.leg: Stromboli - Panarea optional (rehearsal 27 Sep; trip 6 Oct)
passage_notes.note: 9.2 kt run, 'go'; interval-max gust 28 kt against a 9 kt mean from a single model in light air.
1.2 kt run - motoring. Last hour of forecast coverage.

cautions: The forecast horizon ends 29 Sep 23:00; every trip date from 4 Oct onward is unforecast. Treat all rehearsal verdicts as an analysis check, not an outlook.
Gust figures from ECMWF IFS are interval maxima, so in light air they read high (e.g. 26.8 kt at Stromboli against a 10.6 kt mean at midnight 23 Sep) - do not plan sail choice around them.
Where models split by more than 6 kt the payload says so: Lipari 00:00 on 23 Sep spans 3.2-10.5 kt, and 06:00 on 25 Sep spans 1.7-7.8 kt.

Stromboli's Marina del Gabbiano scored only 'workable' (0.766) in the rehearsal - open from every direction, so any NE flow puts it on the nose. Worth a plan B if that overnight stays on the itinerary.
briefing.confidence_note: The pattern description for the next few days is well supported - stability checks show mean wind shifts of only 1.0-1.8 kt between runs, though direction shifts average 57 deg at 72-120 h - but the trip dates lie entirely beyond the 29 Sep forecast reach, so confidence for the flotilla itself is low.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
